nodes.label: Cortex, membrane and motor construction geometry

card.title: Cortex, membrane and motor construction geometry
card.expression: r_shell = R - a_realized^2/(6R) - erm.r0 - h/2; N_cortex = round(4*pi*r_shell^2*density); N_NMII uses the same shell area
card.qualification: a_realized is the realized mesh edge, not simply the input target spacing. Shared geometry does not establish biological abundance covariance.

nodes.label: ERM abundance, capture and occupancy are different quantities

card.title: ERM abundance, capture and occupancy are different quantities
card.expression: capacity = min(round(density*A_built), membrane_nodes); ideal_zero_load_fraction = k_on/(k_on+k_off0); Fchar = kBT/x_beta
card.qualification: The fraction is the stationary two-state rate-matrix result before geometric capture and load limits. Capacity is not realized occupied links.

nodes.label: IF architecture and nuclear size share a construction rule

card.title: IF architecture and nuclear size share a construction rule
card.expression: Rn = R*nc_ratio; shell = Rn+gap; historical_span = r_cortex-Rn-2*gap; r_mid = Rn+gap+historical_span/2; contour_target = 4*pi*r_mid^2*historical_span/mesh^2; rings = round(contour_target/(2*pi*shell)); EA = E*pi*r^2; kappa = E*pi*r^4/4
card.qualification: Contour preservation from a former spoke construction is an explicit model choice. It is not a measured IF density law. Surface remapping changes realized contour.

card.title: Material quantities become geometry-dependent coefficients
card.expression: axial = EA/chord; bend = kappa/mean(adjacent_chords); node_mass = rho*pi*r^2*sum(incident_chords)/2
card.qualification: These are derived coefficients on realized geometry, not additional biological free parameters.

nodes.label: Membrane excess area and its geometric carriers

card.title: Membrane excess area and its geometric carriers
card.expression: f_wrinkle = max(f_total - f_tubes, 0); f_tubes = A_tubed_mesh/A_smooth_mesh - 1; f_tubes cannot exceed f_total
card.qualification: The implemented tube area is measured from constructed geometry. A cylinder-area approximation is not the implemented exact budget.

nodes.label: Motor chemistry shares temperature and nucleotide context

card.title: Motor chemistry shares temperature and nucleotide context
card.expression: kBT = 1.380649e-5*T; Fchar = kBT/x; MgATP_fraction = Mg_free/(Kd+Mg_free); association_rate = association_coefficient*MgATP_fraction*ATP_concentration
card.qualification: Free Mg and total ATP are distinct. Source-derived actin bending stiffness is a stored literal; changing temperature does not recompute that parameter.

nodes.label: Transport speed, priming and lifetime consistency

card.title: Transport speed, priming and lifetime consistency
card.expression: walk rates = v/(spacing*f), v/(spacing*(1-f)); expected run length = v/k_off0; existing guard compares expected/stated run length
card.qualification: One node-spacing event represents multiple molecular cycles. Molecular step-size statistics cannot be inferred from these events. The atlas does not change the guard tolerance.

nodes.label: Assembled motors, competent heads and cycle occupancy

card.title: Assembled motors, competent heads and cycle occupancy
card.expression: assembled_heads = 2*heads_per_side*N_assembled; with object_life: p_assembled = ka/(ka+kd), N_total = round(N_assembled/p_assembled); built_heads = 2*heads_per_side*N_total; three-state zero-load pi proportional to (1,a/(b+c),a*c/(d*(b+c)))
card.qualification: The stationary expression uses a=k_on, b=k_off0, c=k_stroke, d=k_adp_release. It does not apply to five/seven/eight-state cycles, geometric capture constraints or load-dependent duty. In this implementation competent_head_fraction directly validates and returns nmii.rlc_phosphorylated_fraction. Whole-object assembly and cycle occupancy remain separate. When object_life is off, N_total=N_assembled. If ka=kd=0 the implementation uses no reserve; ka=0 with kd>0 refuses.

card.expression: lamina vertices = round(4*pi*Rn^2/lamina.filament^2); lamina-envelope links limited by round(linc_density*A_envelope) and available nodes; chromatin crosslinks = round(0.5*crosslink_fraction*domain_count)
card.qualification: Shared linc.k does not establish empirical equality of mechanics. linc.tension is an observer comparison row, not a stiffness input.

card.qualification: Conditional on water_permeation. Fixed impermeant solute counts do not model arbitrary small-solute equilibration. Surface pressure/volume penalties and double-sheet cases have explicit refusals.

card.qualification: Single-pore G is mislabeled with areal Lp units in the current docstring; this card reports dimensional algebra, not a runtime fix. The cylinder formula omits entrance and mesh resistance.

review.name: actin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of built filament subunits carrying cofilin. THIS ROW STANDS IN FOR BINDING KINETICS THAT ARE NOT WIRED: no cofilin binding row exists in this file (nor on codex/bio-wiring-20260915, whose cofilin path is a 64-row molecular G/F preparation that is not ported), so the decoration cannot be computed from the file and is DECLARED. Sized from stoichiometry and from what cofilin does in a resting cell, not from any gate: one cofilin per actin protomer against actin_chem.cofilin_conc 20 uM and the filament this spec builds puts the hard ceiling at 0.0987 on the shipped build (1.021e7 molecules against 1.035e8 built protomers; cell/severing.decorated_fraction_ceiling recomputes it from the BUILT protomer count and refuses anything above it, with both counts in the message); and most cofilin in a resting cell is Ser3-phosphorylated and cannot bind F-actin at all, so the resting decoration sits well under that ceiling. 0.05 is an order-of-magnitude EXAMPLE inside it and a PI-GAP inference target, not a measurement. WARNING the real law (Kadzik 2026, aleph/laws/cofilin_severing.py) severs at decorated/bare BOUNDARIES and peaks at INTERMEDIATE decoration, while the uniform-rate form this row feeds is monotone in it — no run may claim the occupancy dependence. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

review.name: arp23.nucleation_reserve_fraction

declaration.source: SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

review.name: cortex.proximal_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of cortex filaments laid in the membrane-proximal HALF of the shell (build/cortex._depth; 0.5 = uniform through the thickness, the pre-2026-09-17 build). The cortex is densest under the membrane (Clark 2013 Biophys J 105:570 — cortical actin within ~100-200 nm of the membrane, thickness profile from super-resolution; Chugh 2017 Nat Cell Biol 19:689 — thickness/density set by the length distribution): a value above 0.5 puts that structure in. RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.15: at 0.5, 9.1 % of membrane vertices are farther than erm.reach (45 nm) from any cortex segment at build. Not sourced as a number; SET 0.8 on 2026-09-17 11:15 from the build measurement (RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.16, NMII minifilaments on the same profile): membrane vertices beyond erm.reach 9.1 % (0.5) -> 2.4 % (0.8), NMII heads beyond crossbridge.reach 14.4 % -> 12.8 %; 0.9 was not taken (the profile then has 90 % of the cortex in 100 nm, beyond what the density literature supports).

FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. review.name: crosslink.molecular_model

declaration.source: WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

declaration.source: BOUND 2026-09-16 21:14 at 4.0 = twice the lamina-shell estimate's top: P8s (4.0, dt 1e-4, 30 steps) read 0/0 folds and area_res 0.003/0.024/0.036 (PASS), P8q (2.0) 0/3 folds but area_res 0.887 at k=30 (fails the 0.3 line), P8p (8.3) 0.100. Earlier: PI decision 2026-09-16 18:57 (RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.3-s10.8): the nuclear envelope's bending rigidity is the LAMINA SHELL's, not a bilayer's. Shell estimate kappa = K h^2 / 12 with K = 2.5e4 pN/um (Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779, lamina 2-D modulus, audit OK) and h = 15-30 nm -> 0.5-2.0 pN.um (6-25x the bilayer's 0.083 = 20 kT that stood here until 09-16); 2.0 is the shell estimate's top. review.name: envelope.mu_2d

declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

review.name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

review.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. record.anchor: Table1; Figures1–2; Methods
record.finding: The current association .21 and release .00202 are reported, but come from different setups. Association to formin-bound ends is .21 in setup1 and .08 in setup2. Release in setup2 is inferred from resumption of growth and competing fates. Figure 2c and Results also report nearly overlapping BFC-to-BF regrowth curves across the two setups, allowing CP exit to be inferred in both. The setup distinction alone is not evidence of contradictory release kinetics.

measured_or_model_context.assay: Room-temperature microfluidic TIRF. Setup1 pointed-seed anchoring/10% labeled actin; setup2 anchored formin, labeled seed then unlabeled elongation segment.
measured_or_model_context.buffer: 50mM KCl,5mM Tris pH7.8,.2mM ATP,1mM MgCl2,.2mM EGTA,10mM DTT,1mM DABCO; typical1uM actin/4uM profilin.
measured_or_model_context.denominator: CP binding a formin-bearing end; release from a ternary end, not free-end uncapping.

record.target_transfer_caveat: Do not treat the current pair as one fitted pair or interpret setup differences as a statistical interval.
record.uncertainty_and_sample_size: Table1 errors SEM. Setup1 association groups n36/27/29 filaments at200/100/50nM CP. Off inference combines total exit rate and fate fraction; no covariance matrix provided.
derivation_assumptions: Exponential survival and competing CP/formin exit partition; resumption identifies fate indirectly.

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §2, §6). Sourced as the DATASET pair with erm.k_off0 = 1.3/s (PI decision J): every in-cell observation needs occupancy 0.75-0.9 — Coscoy 2002 PNAS 99:12813 (10.1073/pnas.192084599) two-photon FRAP, 25 % of membrane ezrin exchanging on tau = 5.7 s, rest on 1-2 min; Alert 2015 rho_b*/rho_0 ~ 0.9; Diz-Munoz 2010 density — and with k_off0 1.3 that occupancy is k_on*P ~ 4-12/s (0.88 at 10). record.name: erm.reach

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §3, §6). A pairing filter on the node lattice, not a bond length: the native cortex has 4.59 M nodes in a 0.2 um shell (~0.031 um apart) with its edge at depth 0.018-0.020 um, so a membrane vertex's nearest cortex NODE is at median 0.034 um and the former 0.025 paired 8-11 % of vertices (RESULT-2026-09-10-fixed-build-first-row; Monte-Carlo erm_reach_coverage.json: 0.045 -> 92 %, 0.050 -> 98 %). Inside the molecule: ERM monomer span 10-50 nm, live membrane-cortex boundary gap <10 / <=20 nm (Clausen ... Fritzsche, Eggeling 2017 J Phys D 50:064002, 10.1088/1361-6463/aa52a1, STED on live Jurkat). Every pair RESTS at its built distance (bonds.attach; occupy_at_build a693ab1f) so no initial-load cap is needed — Bell at erm.k 4600 and x_beta 0.7 nm gives k_off(115 pN) ~ 2e8/s, a pair rested at r0 with 25 nm of stretch would die in one step. erm.r0 = 0.020 is the unstressed span. Replaces PI-GAP card E4

record.name: chem.ph

declaration.source: cytosolic pH ~7.2. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

detail.law: pH sets the protonation of every rate that has an acid-base step (free Mg2+ speciating the nucleotide pool was the other half of this entry and is IMPLEMENTED — SPECIATION_ROWS)
detail.blocker: a pH-dependent rate needs a rate row measured AGAINST pH, and this corpus contains none: of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH at all (pinned by tests/product/cell/test_bounded_omissions.py). Verified again on 2026-09-21 by the bundle-kind/speciation lane over spec.example.toml and the codex/bio-wiring-20260915 source branch: no pH-dependent rate law exists on either. Writing one would be inventing a law, which the lane brief forbids, so this row STOPS here. The screening half of the old entry is also still unbuildable: no relation kind carries a charge, and giving one a charge is a resolution decision (see the bound), not a missing line of code
detail.bound: E' P2 / P3, two numbers. (i) SCREENING: at chem.ionic_strength 150 mM the Debye length is 0.8 nm — 1/56 of the SHORTEST interaction reach in the spec (erm.reach 45 nm) and 1/62 of resolution.spacing, so a screened term is exp(-56) = 3.7e-25 of an unscreened one at the closest distance this model resolves. (ii) SPECIATION, kept as the PREDICTION the device run is compared with now that the law is BUILT: at chem.mg_free 500 uM and chem.mgatp_kd 100 uM (a spec row since 2026-09-21; it was literature-only when this bound was written), [MgATP] is 0.8333 x chem.atp_conc, so the ATP-binding edge runs at 2500 /s instead of 3000 /s and the crossbridge cycle time 0.486 s (sum of 1/k_adp_release, 1/k_stroke, 1/k_pi_release, 1/k_hydrolysis, 1/(k_atp_bind x atp_conc)) lengthens by 0.014 %; even at a 10x weaker Kd of 1000 uM it is 0.137 %
detail.verdict: SMALL FOR THIS ENGINE — the screened term is below floating-point at the model's own resolution, and Mg-ATP speciation (now BUILT) moves the crossbridge cycle by 0.014 % (0.14 % at a 10x weaker Kd), far inside the spread the rate rows already declare. The honesty this number does NOT buy: chem.mg_free and chem.ph are often called "the conditions the rates were measured at", and reading the sources says otherwise — of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH, and the 3 that state Mg (Pollard 1986) state 1 mM TOTAL MgCl2 at 22 C in 50 mM KCl (ionic strength ~53 mM), not 0.5 mM FREE Mg at 150 mM. So the transfer error in those rows is UNBOUNDED by anything in this file; what is bounded here is only this engine's sensitivity. Closing that needs the sources read and their conditions written into the rows (a KB item, INVENTORY E' P3)

record.name: crosslink.k

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

record.name: crosslink.molecular_model

declaration.source: WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

record.name: microtubule.dimer_rise

declaration.source: the lattice rise of one tubulin dimer, 8 nm — the end-stroke unit delta of the microtubule family, which is what makes growth_speed a DERIVED on-rate: k_on = growth_speed / (dimer_rise * tubulin_conc) [1/(uM.s)] and the shrink off-rate k_off_b = shrink_speed / dimer_rise [1/s]. LOAD HAZARD, stated where the number is: the on-law multiplies by exp(f*delta/kT), so with delta = 0.008 um and kT = 4.28e-3 pN.um (310 K) one pN of slot load is exp(1.87) = 6.5x and 10 pN is exp(18.7) = 1.3e8 — end_growth clamps the exponent at 50 (f = 26.8 pN), which is a runaway, not a limit. The microtubule family therefore runs under the DECLARED zero load (growth_load = 'zero', the live operating point for actin too); growth_load = 'stretch' is refused for it in assemble.wire_growth. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

record.name: envelope.mu_2d

declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

record.name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

record.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

Duplicate registry UIDs remain separate even when their DOI is identical.
